messages.subject: Issue with mixtureSummaryTable and readModels
parts:
Hi,

I'm currently using the mixtureSummaryTable function to summarize several mixture models, particularly for comparing model fits. I've encountered an issue where the objects in mixtureSummaryTable returned by readModels("nameofMplusoutfile.out", what="summaries")$summaries don't seem to function as effectively as extractModelSummaries, which is now deprecated.

Could anyone please provide any guidance or workaround to address this issue? Any help would be greatly appreciated!

Thanks!
